comment: The model catalogue, keyed by NAME — not a provider table. Nearly every server speaks the OpenAI protocol and differs only in its base_url, so a new server is a new entry here rather than a code change. An agent's `model:` key selects an entry; a key that is not listed is taken as a model id served by the default entry's endpoint. Edit this file, redeploy, reload — no rebuild. Your own edits in Settings are stored in this browser and layered on top of whatever this file says. One entry is NOT in this file and cannot be: `on-device`, the model built into the browser itself, is added at boot only where this browser actually offers one (Chrome's Prompt API) — see crates/adapters_web/src/ondevice.rs. Each entry's `note` is shown in Settings beside the picker.

local.note: The local omlx server. Reachable from a page served from localhost. From the hosted origin, Chrome 142+ asks permission before a page may call a local address, and the call goes through only if it is granted.

openrouter.note: Live-probed browser-callable from this origin (RESEARCH.md, provider CORS). Bring a scoped, credit-limited key.

sonnet.note: Carried from the Python catalogue for parity. `kind: anthropic` is the Messages wire protocol, which this build does not speak yet — selecting it refuses in words rather than sending the wrong bytes.
